name: A Plague Upon Thee
summary: Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp asks you to release Plagueland termites in Northridge Lumber Mill. He needs a barrel of them brought back to the camp.

sections.title: At the Mill
sections.body: At Northridge Lumber Mill, you release the Plagueland termites. Then you bring their barrel to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

faq.answer: Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp asks you to bring him a barrel of Plagueland termites.

faq.q: Where do I release the termites?
faq.answer: You release the Plagueland termites in Northridge Lumber Mill.
Nathaniel Dumah is at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

faq.q: What does Nathaniel need brought back?
faq.answer: Nathaniel Dumah asks you to return with a barrel of Plagueland termites.
